Apple-Foundation-Models-Backend-PoC.why: This was a plan to use Apple's on-device model as an agent for CW; it was never made, and today any agent with an HTTP endpoint can do the work through CW_AGENT_ENDPOINT.

Boundary-Contracts.why: The rules at the agent edge (output schema checks, the token budget, and the one-way type wall) are now one part of the Architecture Principles page.

CLI-MCP-Parity.why: How the CLI and the MCP server are kept in step is now one part of the MCP And Manifests page.

CLI-and-MCP-Surface.why: This was a second list of the same commands; there is one list now.

Capability-and-Topology-Registry.why: The topology registry was taken out in 0.3.1 with the multi-agent family, and the capability registry is now one part of the MCP And Manifests page.

Concurrent-Failure-Semantics.why: What CW does when agents run side by side and some of them fail or hang is now one part of the Architecture Principles page.

Contract-Migration-Tooling.why: How CW loads run state made by an older CW (cw state check, cw migration) is now one part of the Operations page.

Control-Plane-Scheduling.why: The run queue is one part of the Run Registry page; the scheduling verbs (cw schedule, cw sched, cw routine) were taken out on 2026-11-12.

Distribution-Strategy.why: The ways to put CW on your machine (npm, npx, and Homebrew) are now in Getting Started.

Execution-Backends.why: The execution backends (agent, node, bun, shell, container, remote, ci) are now one part of the Architecture page.

GitHub-Showcase-Architecture.why: This was an early copy of the Architecture page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Commands-or-API.why: This was an early copy of the Commands or API page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-FAQ.why: This was an early copy of the FAQ page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Home.why: This was an early copy of the Home page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-MCP-And-Manifests.why: This was an early copy of the MCP And Manifests page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Operations.why: This was an early copy of the Operations page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Quickstart.why: This was an early copy of the Quickstart page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Recovery-And-Restore.why: This was an early copy of the Recovery And Restore page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Trust-And-Audit.why: This was an early copy of the Trust And Audit page; there is one copy now.

GitHub-Showcase-Workflow-Apps.why: This was an early copy of the Workflow Apps page; there is one copy now.

Manifesto:-Agents-Need-FreeBSD.why: The argument of this essay, that agents need a small base system and not one more framework, is now one part of the Origin Story page.

Multi-Agent-Topologies.why: Topologies, the blackboard, and the coordinator were taken out in 0.3.1 with the multi-agent family; to get agents working together today, give the work its shape with a workflow app.

Node-Snapshot-Diff-Replay.why: Taking a snapshot of one step of a run, and comparing and replaying it (cw node), is now one part of the Recovery And Restore page.

Observability-Cost-Accounting.why: Run time, failure rates, and signed token use (cw metrics) are now one part of the Operations page.

Project-Index.why: This was a copy of the project index as it was at 0.2.6; the index is now made from the code in the repo, and the Repo Map page has a link to it.

Real-Execution-Backends.why: The container, remote, and ci backends are now one part of the Architecture page.

Release-Tooling.why: How a release is checked, reviewed, signed, and cut is now one part of the Operations page.

Runtime-Contract.why: The way a run goes from plan to report is now one part of the Architecture page.

Side-Story:-One-Frame,-Five-Lenses.why: This story has a shorter page name now; the story is the same.

Team-Collaboration.why: Approvals, comments, and handoffs (cw approve, cw comment, cw handoff) were taken out in 0.3.1 with the multi-agent family; to hand work between agents in two repos, use cw ledger.

Telemetry-Attestation-and-Tamper-Evidenc.why: The signed usage ledger and how CW sees any later change to it are now one part of the Trust And Audit page.

The-Car-Metaphor.why: The car story (CW is the car, the model is the engine, tokens are the fuel) is now one part of the Mental Model page.

Web-Desktop-Workbench.why: The Workbench was taken out on 2026-11-12; a run's report and the operator views are in the Operations page.
